name: The Heron

perks.name: Ballistic Tuning
perks.desc:
Power diverted from shield.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases shield duration

perks.name: Supercooled Accelerator
perks.desc:
Optimized for extended range.
  •  Increases range
  •  Slightly decreases reload speed
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Tempered Truss Rod
perks.desc:
High stiffness for quick handling.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases reload speed
  •  Slightly decreases range

perks.name: Low-Impedance Windings
perks.desc:
Improved output efficiency.
  •  Increases shield duration
  •  Slightly increases reload speed
  •  Decreases range

perks.name: Auxiliary Reserves
perks.desc:
Additional energy storage.
  •  Greatly increases shield duration
  •  Decreases reload speed

perks.name: Lightweight Emitter
perks.desc:
Weight reduction for better agility.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases handling speed
  •  Decreases shield duration

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Alloy Magazine
perks.desc: Faster reload when the magazine is nearly empty.

perks.name: Appended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon's magazine is built for higher capacity.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Swap Mag
perks.desc: Increases this weapon's ready and stow speed.

perks.name: Light Mag
perks.desc:
Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Proximity Power
perks.desc: When targets are nearby, final blows grant bonus Melee stat.

perks.name: Replenishing Aegis
perks.desc: Blocking damage partially reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.desc: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.desc: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.desc: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Overflow
perks.desc: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo automatically loads this weapon beyond normal capacity.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.desc: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

perks.name: Redirection
perks.desc: Damaging rank-and-file combatants increases damage against more powerful ones.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.desc: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.desc: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Unstoppable Force
perks.desc: Blocking damage with your shield increases projectile damage for a short time.

perks.name: Close to Melee
perks.desc: Glaive projectile final blows improve Glaive melee damage. Glaive projectile or melee damage extends the duration.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Nail, Meet Hammer
perks.desc: This weapon is more effective against combatant shields. Destroying a shield with this weapon grants bonus Special ammo progress if it uses Primary or Heavy ammo, or Heavy ammo progress if it uses Special ammo.

notes: Inspired by @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-MajorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for burst damage against shielded Elites, Banes, Champions and Minibosses general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. The Heron is an aggressive glaive which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic having the best overall damage profile among glaives. The stats are in-band by comparison with its peers - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/2246386812 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. With this frame type having low Handling and Reload Speed, use the haft and magazine perks to help either or both out. This is the first non-endgame activity glaive that can drop with the trait perk combination of Disruption Break which increases kinetic damage by ×1.5 after breaking an elemental shield with Close to Melee providing a +60% boost to the kinetic glaive melee for 10s (11s when enhanced) refreshable by up to 5s on additional melee or projectile hits. Alternatively, Binary Orbit provides a ×1.25 damage boost for the projectile, to help with a shield break, for a refreshable 8.5s (10.5s enhanced) after any kill with a kinetic or darkness energy alignment. For the Origin Trait, Nail, Meet Hammer grants ×1.08 damage against shields, and an additional 8% Heavy Ammo progress when initially breaking the shield. I've no evidence for this, but I'd like the name to be a reference from the "Wheel of Time" saga, where the Heron mark on a sword is an indication of the status of Blademaster, which would make some sort of sense. Recommended MW: Draw Time, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
